newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman details Southwest Air.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman details Southwest Air.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Brian Harris said he upgraded Southwest Airlines Co to buy from outperform.
-- raised the second quarter earnings estimate to $0.60 a share from $0.55 a share and increased the full-year 1997 earnings estimate to $1.85 a share from $1.57 a share.
-- said expects earnings momentum to be "quite strong."
-- said Southwest is getting a better mix of business and leisure passenger traffic.
-- Southwest lost 3/4 to 25-3/8 in afternoon trading.
